unreadable: Variotec/Aprico/Junior are building-door/sliding wall products listed under 'In building' on Hawa's site, not in the 'On furniture' catalogue; Hawa furniture lines covered instead are Combino, Clipo, Concepta III, Folding Concepta III, Concepta 40/50. Not covered: Hawa Frontino (data only via Haefele UK p1.79A), Regal, Libra, Miniroll, 220 Planfront, Creation, Frontal, Multifold, Aperto, Concepta lll 15 weight tables

notes: All Hettich data are from the 2021 catalogue (HET-CAT21); 'cat p.N' = printed page, PDF page = N+2. Hawa 'cat p.N' likewise N+2 for pdf. Blum pdf page = printed page.
Values marked [drawing] were read off rendered drawing images (dimension labels); semantics of unlabelled dimensions are my reading and flagged lower confidence.
CONFLICT TopLine XL height: cat p.3 comparison table says 2600 mm max; cat p.6 performance graph and Hettich spec sheet say up to 3000 mm.
CONFLICT TopLine XL width: cat p.3 table 600-2000; spec sheet 2-door 600-1000 / 3-door 750-1350 / 4-door 650-1000; cat p.6 graph lists 600-2000 / 750-1350 / 650-1000 (graph legend ambiguous).
CONFLICT TopLine L width: cat p.3/p.14 550-1500 and graph also 550-1350 (the second range probably applies to a different condition, ambiguous).

Hawa Combino/Clipo spec-box numbers (weight, height, width, thickness) have icons only; order weight/height/width/thickness verified against Concepta SPE text and 80 H FS (2800 x 1600) but not explicitly labelled in the catalogue text layer.

Hawa Combino door formulas use KIM / KAM; legend not found in the catalogue (German abbreviations Korpus-Innenmass / Korpus-Aussenmass; drawings consistent with inside / outside cabinet width). Overlap implied: IS 2-door 26 mm total, 3-door 56; MS 16/36; FS 16/36 (i.e. TB = (W + overlap_total)/n).
Hawa Concepta III 'RE' in KT1 >= T1 + RE is not defined in the drawing legend.

Blum REVEGO: a web-search snippet claimed internal depth 553 (Canada); the official GB and CA pages and the ordering guide give internal depth from 518 (uno)/483 (duo) and pocket depth from 553 - no real conflict, snippet was wrong.
